en-US.name: Agent Reach
en-US.summary: Web research and social search across Xiaohongshu, X/Twitter, Bilibili, Reddit, YouTube and more. Install Agent Reach and required third-party CLIs separately, and authorize the relevant platform accounts.

zh-CN.name: Agent Reach
zh-CN.summary: 全网调研与社媒搜索：覆盖小红书、X/Twitter、B 站、Reddit、YouTube 等平台的内容检索与信息聚合。需自行安装 Agent Reach 及所需第三方 CLI，并授权对应平台账号。

requirements.value: User-installed Agent Reach and the platform CLIs required by the chosen channel. Browser-based channels require a user-controlled browser session; no fixed conda environment is assumed.

The operator authorizes platform accounts and any cookie or browser-session access. Platform restrictions and optional service costs apply separately; stop when authorization or a channel is unavailable.
